{{Quote|Jedi poodoo!|Seboca|audio=Seboca.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Seboca''' was a [[Dug]] [[holovid]] [[Actor|star]] from<ref name="SWCL" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="SWVE" /> [[Malastare]].<ref name="SWCL" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> the Dug was entertaining [[Senator]] [[Bogg Tyrell]] while she<ref name="SWCL" /> [[pilot]]ed a [[speeder]] through the [[skylane]]s of the planet [[Coruscant]]. The pair were interrupted when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] nearly collided with their vehicle while hanging from the [[assassin droid]] [[ASN-121]], forcing Tyrell to swerve and cry out.<ref name="AOTC" />

Seboca then cursed at Kenobi in [[Huttese]] as the [[Jedi]] was carried away. The star later sat in a booth with the [[Nuknog]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Slyther Bushforb]]<ref name="Bushforb">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690195877064705|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-27|quote=These are two Podracer models re-dressed and repurposed as new characters. Ark "Bumpy" Roose is now Slyther Bushforb, and Ebe Endicott is Oby Bobissia. A CG Mars Guo re-dress was planned but never made it to screen.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> and fellow Dug<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Rednax]]<ref name="Rednax">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690415738261508|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-30|quote=The Sebulba and Ratts Tyerell re-dresses became Sedoca / Rednax and Bogg Tyrell, and are seen in the Coruscant speeder chase and in the diner as well.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> at [[Dex's Diner]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in the [[CoCo Town]] district<ref name="SWCL" /> when Kenobi entered the establishment. Tyrell also entered the diner shortly after Kenobi's arrival, after which Seboca got up and left.<ref name="AOTC" /> Seboca wore [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|pants]] and a red shirt that was the latest fashion on Coruscant. The Dug had pink skin with a blue [[nose]], orange [[eye]]s, and black slicked-back [[hair]].<ref name="SWVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seboca was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2016 Topps Star Wars: Attack of the Clones 3D Widevision|cardname=Matthew Wood as Seboca|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/194113/cid/12380975/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Attack-of-the-Clones-Widevison-3Di---Autographs-NNO-Matthew-Wood}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Yby">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character was created by modifying the computer-generated model of [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Sebulba]] made for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Chronicle">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']].<ref name="SWCL" /> The name Seboca was first used in a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[StarWars.com]] databank entry for [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], released by [[August 9]], 2002. It identified one of the patrons of the diner as Seboca,<ref name="DinerDB">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> although during production of the film the names for the two [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] in the diner were Rednax and Manoca.<ref name="Insider63" /> Work on the animated shots in Dex's Diner was completed between [[April]] and [[May]], [[2001]], with the finalized renders then completed over the summer.<ref name="Insider63">{{InsiderCite|63|Behind the Magic}}</ref>

[[File:Rednax_and_Seboca.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Seboca and Rednax sit oppostie one another in a booth at Dex's Diner.|Seboca (background) and Rednax (foreground) were both at different points known as Manoca.]]
A "[[Behind the Magic]]" article written by [[Rob Coleman]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 63|sixty-third issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider63" />—published [[November 5]], 2002—<ref name="63Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2002/10/news20021017.html|text=Creatures Aplenty in Insider #63}}</ref> identified the non-spotted Dug in the diner as Rednax and the other spotted Dug as Manoca.<ref name="Insider63" /> In later sources,<ref name="Depth">{{Film|II}} DVD-ROM Depth Commentary</ref><ref name="Image">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/09/imageattack20030909.html|series=Image Attack|text=Dug Model}}</ref> the identities were then switched, with Rednax first identified as the spotted Dug in an Episode II Depth Commentary available on StarWars.com that was accessible through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>

In the "[[Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A]]" section of [[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]],<ref name="Insider66">{{InsiderCite|66|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> released on [[March 4]], [[2003]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/02/news20030203.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #66}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]] identified Seboca as the Dug seen earlier in the film, but still identified the two diner dugs as Rednax and Manoca.<ref name="Insider66" /> In a blog post made on [[October 10]], [[2006]], Chee then clarified that the spotted Dug at the diner was Rednax and the other was Seboca, as the two non-spotted Dugs had identical models other than their hair. This left no character named Manoca,<ref name="Holocron">{{Blog|holocron|29|Mistaken Identities}}</ref> although it was later established to be a pseudonym used by Seboca in the Databank entry for [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]] written by [[John Hazlett]] as part of the "[[What's The Story?]]" contest<ref name="Hazlett">{{Blog|jSarek|6|Behind the Scenes - Slyther Bushforb}}</ref> and published around [[March 27]], [[2008]].<ref name="jcf">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28246564|board=Literature|thread=Official "What's the Story?" Hyperspace Databank Feature Discussion|user=kttch809|date=2008-03-27|time=7:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150915174927/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/official-whats-the-story-hyperspace-databank-feature-discussion.20434695/page-96|nolive=1}}</ref>
